'''Sibylla''' {{Lang|zh=西比尔}} is a deceased, quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears in {{Quest|By Moon's Fated Light}}. She's the mother of [[Iuno]] and was a fierce gladiator who perished during a battle against the Dark Tide.
